story_type: spy plane landing guided by a chase car racing behind it
hook: This spy plane needs a car to chase it down the runway.
narration: This spy plane needs a car racing right behind it to land.
It's the U-2 Dragon Lady, and at Beale Air Force Base in California, chase cars are part of every landing.
From the cockpit, the pilot has limited movement and vision.
So a chase car driver, a former U-2 pilot, races up behind the tail and tells the pilot how close the jet is to the runway.
The U-2 lands on two main wheels set in a line, like a bicycle, so the last few feet decide whether a wingtip scrapes first.
[short pause] On a touch and go, the pilot sets it down, then powers straight back into the sky.
outcome: The U-2 came back down with the car right on its tail, then taxied in to be parked.
title: Spy plane lands with a car on its tail
description:
A U-2 Dragon Lady reconnaissance aircraft takes off, lands and flies touch-and-goes at Beale Air Force Base, California, with the chase cars that follow every U-2 landing.
